versions.short: The bill would add the Bay Area Ridge National Scenic Trail to a list of trails that the federal government must study for possible inclusion in the National Trails System. The proposed trail would be a multi-use route of about 550 miles along the ridgelines around the San Francisco Bay Area in northern California, connecting more than 75 parks and open spaces. The study would be carried out together with state, Tribal, and local government agencies and other interested groups, including the Bay Area Ridge Trail Council.
